snippet.title: ToneTrek – Feature Highlights with Gameplay
snippet.description:
Get a first look at some of the key features in ToneTrek, our upcoming color-based puzzle game! 🎮🧩

▶️ In this video:
– Campaign mode & single level mode
– Multiple difficulty levels from simple to complex
– Customizable color schemes & tile styles
– Different game modes to match your play style

🎧 Note: User interface and sound effects are not final, and gameplay is still subject to change.

📣 Follow us on Facebook for updates:
https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61564462991559

🧪 Stay tuned — a playable demo is coming soon!

#ToneTrek #PuzzleGame #IndieGameDev #FeatureDemo #ComingSoon
